results.comment: I've noticed that there's another huge clue that was missed on the theory of Stan being connected to bill on a deeper level. In the opening sequence, when the whisper in reverse is reversed, you get "Three letters back" (I think). This hint works for solving the cryptogram in the cipher wheel at the end of the opening sequence, but interestingly enough, this also works for a cryptogram in Stan's mind during Dreamscaperers (S1E19), which is even shown at 13:51. By using the "Three letters back" trick, we can figure out that this says "Mystery shack", which shows that Stan's mind has some form of correlation with the same cryptogram seen twice in relation to Bill. Once in the Cipher wheel at the end of the opening sequence, and once in the Weirdmageddon (S2E18) opening sequence, where for a split second, you can see "Gravity Falls" on the water tower get replaced with a cryptogram that, using the "Three letters back" trick, says Gravity Falls.
